runners.comment: Chance of winning may depend on whether the tongue-tie prompts improvement
runners.name: Karma De Cotte
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-5 in Irish points and 0-4 under rules; proving consistent but chance of winning may depend on whether the fitting of tongue-tie prompts improvement.

runners.comment: Solid form last summer/autumn; seemed to need latest run; worth another chance
runners.name: Ryebridge
runners.spotlight: The form he showed last summer/autumn has been franked by the winners since; faded into fourth, seeming in need of the run, last month on handicap debut and return from break; worth another chance.

runners.comment: Shaped with promise on penultimate start; may improve now handicapping
runners.name: Gaelic Glow
runners.spotlight: Not entirely solid on form but shaped with promise on penultimate start, catching the attention of the stewards, and may improve now handicapping; market support should be heeded.

runners.comment: Chance depends on whether this first start of 2026 results in a turnaround
runners.name: Fourofakind

runners.comment: Absent since autumn; successful over C&D last April and is nicely weighted
runners.name: Rickety Gate
runners.spotlight: Absent since a couple of placed efforts in Class 5 in the autumn; back up in grade but he won a Class 4 contest over C&D last April and is nicely weighted.

runners.name: Mr Lincoln

runners.comment: Very consistent and every chance of being involved off a slightly reduced mark

runners.comment: Continues to fall in the weights and hasn't been running badly of late

runners.name: Ruler Legend

runners.comment: Second here 13 months ago but precious little to crow about since then

runners.spotlight: Finished second over C&D 13 months ago when in first-time cheekpieces but precious little to crow about since then; opposable.

runners.comment: Has a modest overall strike-rate and has been below par of late; 3lb wrong

runners.name: Cuzco Du Mathan

runners.comment: Sedgefield winner; raised 6lb but 5lb of that is removed by Paddy Hanlon's claim

runners.comment: Behind Tanking Along last time and this high a mark is looking troublesome

runners.name: Dalcassian Girl

runners.comment: Good third in cross-country chase last time but far too inconsistent to rely upon nowadays
runners.name: Escaria Ten

runners.comment: Soundly beaten on both starts for new stable this year; revival needed over new trip here

runners.comment: Well beaten last month but has generally done well over fences this season
runners.name: Seasmoke
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on heavy ground last month (jumped poorly) but has generally done well over fences this season, most notably when winning at Market Rasen (3m, good to soft) in November; likely contender if last month's wind op and/or first-time cheekpieces aid quick return to form.

runners.comment: 0-10 under rules but ran well when making the frame in two soft-ground chases this year
runners.name: Only Gossip
runners.spotlight: 0-10 under rules but left disappointing chase debut behind when second of ten at Fontwell (3m2f, soft) in January, and last month's Warwick third (3m, soft) was also a good effort; a possible if in similar form on the faster ground here.

runners.comment: Kept on well for third when upped to 2m7f in January and remains on a good mark
runners.name: Sweet Nightingale
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to her good-ground hurdle win in 2022 but looked suited by the step up to 2m7f when keeping-on third at Taunton (good to soft) in January and remains on a good mark; might be the answer.

16:12.race_name: Guildhall Exeter, Shop, Eat, Play EBF Junior "National Hunt" Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Third in good-ground junior hurdles on both starts; probably won't be far away
runners.name: Dakota Star
runners.spotlight: Third in good-ground junior hurdles on both starts, latterly at Taunton a fortnight ago where he lost ground when swerving left after the penultimate flight; probably won't be far away if he avoids any similar antics here.

runners.comment: Out of half-sister to Harchibald; connections have some good junior hurdlers this season
runners.name: Doha Rally
runners.spotlight: 42,000euros 2yo; 13th foal; half-brother to four winners including a French hurdler; dam unraced half-sister to top 2m hurdler Harchibald; connections have some good junior hurdlers this season; watch the betting.

runners.comment: Made the frame in two of his three bumpers; considered each-way on hurdle debut
runners.name: Dont Rein Me In
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in fast-ground course bumper on debut in October and bounced back from a lesser effort when fourth of ten at Hereford (soft) last month; considered each-way on hurdling debut.

runners.comment: With good stable but might be a longer-term project
runners.name: Longmoor
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam placed in point/2m3f hurdle, half-sister to 3m chase winner Presenting Belle; with good stable but might be a longer-term project.

runners.comment: 50-1 for Newbury debut but was very much in contention before penultimate-flight fall
runners.name: Mistral St Georges
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to fairly useful chaser Georges Saint; dam once-raced half-sister to useful jumper Bon Papa; 50-1 for last month's debut at Newbury (2m, good to soft) but very much in contention before falling heavily at penultimate flight; has possibilities here if that experience did not dent his confidence.

runners.comment: Runner-up on both starts (one over C&D); leading contender if suited by this faster ground
runners.name: Mwabani
runners.spotlight: Chased home a subsequent Grade 2 winner over C&D (good to soft) on debut in November and again finished second to a useful rival at Chepstow (soft) last month; leading contender if suited by the quicker ground today.

runners.comment: Out of a smart jumper but was safely held in two good-ground bumpers in the autumn
runners.name: Prince Vinny
runners.spotlight: Out of a smart jumper but was safely held in two good-ground bumpers in the autumn; needs to take a good step forward on this hurdling debut.

runners.comment: Well beaten in two bumpers last month; hurdle debut today
runners.name: Soldier In Defence
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers last month (good to soft/soft) and can only be watched on this hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Made low-key hurdle debut in November and unseated rider mid-race last time
runners.name: Tails Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far when fifth of seven (about 4l behind Don't Rein Me In) in fast-ground course bumper in October but made a low-key hurdle debut the following month and unseated rider mid-race on next outing.

runners.comment: Not disgraced on either hurdling start but low-grade handicaps beckon
runners.name: Clear Sky
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced on either hurdling start (beaten just over 20l both times) but will probably be of greater interest when qualified for handicaps.

16:47.race_name: Guildhall Exeter Style, Flavour, Fun Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Consistent; has nudged up the weights so his rider's 7lb claim is welcomed
runners.name: Diamatiste
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m5f on heavy here 13 months ago; consistent in defeat this season in handicaps at about this distance, running his usual honest race last time at Ascot; has nudged up the weights so his rider's 7lb claim is welcomed; good to soft is fine but he has a bit to prove on good.

runners.comment: Not obviously progressive but it was quite a deep race he ran in at Newbury last time
runners.name: Kayf Dancer
runners.spotlight: Won a weak maiden on this card 12 months ago and hasn't found any improvement this season in handicaps; on the plus side, it was quite a deep race he ran in at Newbury last time.

runners.comment: Novice winner over this far; open to improvement and could return refreshed after a break
runners.name: Court In A Storm
runners.spotlight: The ground has been good for all six runs; won his novice over this far, then fell on handicap debut in October and was perhaps thinking about that when well held at Kempton; open to improvement and could return refreshed after a break.

runners.comment: Hat-trick bid came up shy but he still ran really well and gets in off the same mark here
runners.name: Call Me Legend
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good to soft) and then at Wincanton (3m, heavy) before coming up short in a higher grade (Class 3) at Newbury (3m, good to soft) but still ran well behind the favourite and was clear of the remainder; gets in off the same mark here; good chance.

runners.comment: 2-2 in handicaps and goes well fresh so the break is of no concern
runners.name: Got A Dream
runners.spotlight: Signed off last season in a Graded race and has gone 2-2 switched to handicaps this term, with good-ground wins in the autumn; good value for the narrow winning margin last time (2m5f) and only went up 5lb; goes well fresh so the break is of no concern.

runners.comment: Won this two years ago and went in again here in November; lesser runs have followed
runners.name: Stratton Oakmont
runners.spotlight: Won this race two years ago; as good as ever (after a wind operation) when scoring by over 9l over C&D in November (good) but hasn't offered a great deal since, beaten 22l in staying handicaps at Doncaster and Ascot; others preferred.

runners.comment: Another C&D winner (November) but could have run a lot better on last two outings
runners.name: Ri Na Cuirte
runners.spotlight: Another C&D winner (November) but could have run a lot better on last two outings, latterly only five days ago when tried in a visor; the blinkers return but this is a quick turnaround.

runners.comment: Course winner; has to bounce back after last time but wouldn't put it past him
runners.name: Robbers Bridge
runners.spotlight: Career best when winning by 11l over 2m5f here in January (good to soft) and for whatever reason he didn't turn up at Newbury (2m4f; handles soft); has to bounce back from that but wouldn't put it past him; there are niggling stamina doubts at this trip, however.

17:22.race_name: Greendale Farm Shop Point-To-Point Bumper Maiden National Hunt Flat Race (Amateurs) (Cat 3) (GBB)

runners.comment: Still hard to know what the form is worth but he has won a point bumper on soft
runners.name: Call Me Ken
runners.spotlight: Still hard to know what the form is worth but he won a point bumper on soft ground in early November; hard to rule out.

runners.comment: Forced a dead-heat on soft ground at Larkhill (2m); that form has yet to be truly tested
runners.name: Dadavic
runners.spotlight: Forced a dead-heat on soft ground at Larkhill (2m); that form has yet to be truly tested but he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Some 21l behind Henriettaredheart on debut and then beaten 15l next time, also at Larkhill
runners.name: Just Call Me Buzz
runners.spotlight: Some 21l behind Henriettaredheart on his debut and then beaten 15l next time, also at Larkhill.

runners.comment: Beaten favourite in his latest point but was bought for £50,000 prior to that
runners.name: Prince In The Park
runners.spotlight: Changed hands for £50,000 after finishing third in his second Irish point; failed to justify favouritism at Badbury Rings (3m, good to soft) four weeks ago, finishing third; the runner-up was modest under rules in Ireland, so the form isn't strong; still needs considering in what's not that good a race by the looks.

runners.comment: Beaten in two of these races already, on the first occasion in a race won by Call Me Ken
runners.name: G Whizz
runners.spotlight: Beaten in a couple of these races already, on the first occasion in a race won by Call Me Ken; now has tongue tied.

runners.comment: Narrow winner of a good-ground point bumper at Larkhill in December
runners.name: Henriettaredheart
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner of a good-ground point bumper at Larkhill in December and the third has shown a bit of ability under rules for the Moore yard; has to be of interest.

runners.comment: 4yo who was a clear second in a good-ground point bumper at Larkhill three weeks back
runners.name: Timmie Two
runners.spotlight: 4yo who was a clear second in a good-ground point bumper at Larkhill three weeks back; clearly has some ability and his yard won this two years ago.
